class.name: Dialog
class.brief_description: A modal overlay shown above the Activity stack.
class.description:
Dialog is a full-screen [Control] overlay rendered on top of the Activity stack by [ActivityManager]. It is [b]not[/b] an OS-level window — it uses a [Control] node so it works consistently across all platforms (mobile, web, console, desktop).
The dialog scene typically draws its own semi-transparent backdrop and a centered panel. Lifecycle: [method _on_create] (once) → visible → [method _on_dismiss] (when dismissed).
Each Dialog has an optional [code]lifecycle_owner[/code] — when the owning [Activity] is destroyed, its dialogs are auto-dismissed by [ActivityManager].

method.name: _on_create
method.description: Called once when the Dialog is created, after its scene is instantiated. [param saved_state] receives [member Intent.extras] from the launching [Intent]. Build the UI and set up bindings here.

method.name: _on_dismiss
method.description: Called when the Dialog is being dismissed. Clean up resources, dispose the [ViewModel], etc. You do [b]not[/b] need to call [method dismiss] inside this callback.

method.name: dismiss
method.description: Requests the ActivityManager to dismiss this Dialog. Triggers [method _on_dismiss], plays the exit transition, then removes the node.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the [Context] assigned to this Dialog. The context provides access to Application-wide services.

method.name: get_intent
method.description: Returns the [Intent] used to show this Dialog.

method.name: get_lifecycle_owner
method.description: Returns the object that owns this Dialog's lifecycle. When the owner is destroyed, this Dialog is auto-dismissed.

method.name: show_toast
method.description: Convenience for [method Context.show_toast]. Toast is bound to this Dialog's lifecycle.

members.member: The [Transition] resource for entering the screen.
The [Transition] resource for exiting the screen.
